description: A mid-sized company that sells electronics, software, furniture, office supplies and accessories to business and consumer customers. Data covers January 2023 to October 2026. Money is in USD; dates are ISO strings (YYYY-MM-DD).

departments.description: Organisational departments of the company and where they are based.

columns.department_name: Name of the department, e.g. Engineering or Sales.
columns.location: City where the department is headquartered.
columns.budget: Annual operating budget of the department in USD.

employees.description: Everyone employed by the company, including the CEO and department heads.

columns.email: Work email address of the employee.
columns.job_title: Current job title, e.g. Senior Software Engineer.
columns.department_id: Department the employee belongs to (references departments).
columns.joining_date: Date the employee joined the company (hire date).
columns.manager_id: The employee's direct manager (references employees.employee_id); NULL only for the CEO.

products.description: Catalogue of products the company sells.

columns.category: Product category: Electronics, Software, Furniture, Office Supplies or Accessories.
columns.price: Current list price per unit in USD.
columns.stock_quantity: Units currently in stock (0 means out of stock).

customers.description: Customers (companies or individual consumers) who buy from the company.

columns.customer_name: Company name for Enterprise/SMB customers, person name for Consumers.
columns.city: City where the customer is located.
columns.country: Country where the customer is located.
columns.registration_date: Date the customer account was created.
columns.segment: Customer segment: Enterprise, SMB (small/medium business) or Consumer.

sales.description: One row per sales transaction: which employee sold which product to which customer, and when.

columns.employee_id: Employee who made the sale (references employees).
columns.quantity: Number of units sold in this transaction.
columns.sale_amount: Total value of the transaction in USD after any discount (this is the revenue figure).

projects.description: Internal projects owned by a department.

columns.department_id: Department that owns the project (references departments).
columns.start_date: Date the project started (or is planned to start).
columns.end_date: Date the project finished; NULL if not finished.
columns.status: Project status: Planned, Active, Completed or On Hold.

employee_projects.description: Assignment of employees to projects (many-to-many), with each person's role and allocated hours.

columns.project_id: Project the employee is assigned to (references projects).
columns.role: Role on the project, e.g. Lead, Developer, Analyst.
columns.hours_allocated: Total hours allocated to this employee on the project.

performance_reviews.description: Periodic performance reviews of employees, written by their manager.

columns.reviewer_id: Employee who wrote the review, normally the manager (references employees).
columns.comments: Free-text reviewer comments; may be NULL.
